entrance_antiphon.latin: In excelso throno vidi sedere virum, quem adorat multitudo Angelorum, psallentes in unum: Ecce cuius imperii nomen est in aeternum.
entrance_antiphon.english: Upon a lofty throne, I saw a man seated, whom a host of angels adore, singing in unison: Behold him, the name of whose empire is eternal.

communion_antiphon.latin: Domine apud te est fons vitae et in lumine tuo videbimus lumen.
communion_antiphon.english: With you, O Lord, is the fountain of life, and in your light we see light.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Omnis terra adoret te, Deus, et psallat tibi; psalmum dicat nomini tuo, Altissime.
entrance_antiphon.english: All the earth shall bow down before you, O God, and shall sing to you, shall sing to your name, O Most High!

communion_antiphon.latin: Parasti in conspectu meo mensam, et calix meus inebrians quam praeclarus est.
communion_antiphon.english: You have prepared a table before me, and how precious is the chalice that quenches my thirst.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Cantate Domino canticum novum; cantate Domino omnis terra. Confessio et pulchritudo in conspectu eius; sanctitas et magnificentia in sanctificatione eius.
entrance_antiphon.english: O sing a new song to the Lord; sing to the Lord, all the earth. In his presence are majesty and splendor, strength and honor in his holy place.

communion_antiphon.latin: Accedite ad Dominum et illuminamini, et facies vestrae non confundentur.
communion_antiphon.english: Look toward the Lord and be radiant; let your faces not be abashed.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Salvos nos fac, Domine Deus noster, et congrega nos de nationibus, ut confiteamur nomini sancto tuo, et gloriemur in laude tua.
entrance_antiphon.english: Save us, O Lord our God! And gather us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, and make it our glory to praise you.

communion_antiphon.latin: Illumina faciem tuam super servum tuum, et salvum me fac in tua misericordia. Domine, non confundar, quoniam invocavi te.
communion_antiphon.english: Let your face shine on your servant. Save me in your merciful love. O Lord, let me never be put to shame, for I call on you.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Venite, adoremus, Deum, et procidamus ante Dominum, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dominus Deus noster.
entrance_antiphon.english: O come, let us worship God and bow low before the God who made us, for he is the Lord our God.

communion_antiphon.latin: Confiteantur Domino misericordiae eius, et mirabilia eius filiis hominum, quia satiavit animam inanem et animam esurientem satiavit bonis.
communion_antiphon.english: Let them thank the Lord for his mercy, his wonders for the children of men, for he satisfies the thirsty soul, and the hungry he fills with good things.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Esto mihi in Deum protectorem, et in locum refugii, ut salvum me facias : quoniam firmamentum meum, et refugium meum es tu: et propter nomen tuum dux mihi eris, et enutries me.
entrance_antiphon.english: Be my protector, O God, a mighty stronghold to save me. For you are my rock, my stronghold! Lead me, guide me, for the sake of your name.

communion_antiphon.latin: Manducaverunt, et saturati sunt nimis, et desiderium eorum attulit eis Dominus: non sunt fraudati a desidero suo.
communion_antiphon.english: They ate and had their fill, and what they craved the Lord gave them; they were not disappointed in what they craved.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Domine, in tua misericordia speravi. Exsultavit cor meum in salutari tuo, cantabo Domino, qui bona tribuit mihi.
entrance_antiphon.english: O Lord, I trust in your merciful love. My heart will rejoice in your salvation. I will sing to the Lord who has been bountiful with me.

communion_antiphon.latin: Narrabo omnia mirabilia tua. Laetabor et exsultabo in te, psallam nomini tuo, Altissime.
communion_antiphon.english: I will recount all your wonders, I will rejoice in you and be glad, and sing psalms to your name, O Most High. Or: Domine, ego credidi quia tu es Christus Filius Dei vivi, qui in hunc mundum venisti. Lord, I have come to believe that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God, who is coming into this world.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Factus est Dominus protector meus, et eduxit me in latitudinem, salvum me fecit, quoniam voluit me
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord became my protector. He brought me out to a place of freedom; he saved me because he delighted in me.

communion_antiphon.latin: Cantabo Domino, qui bona tribuit mihi, et psallam nomini Domini Altissimi.
communion_antiphon.english: I will sing to the Lord who has been bountiful with me, sing psalms to the name of the Lord Most High.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Respice in me, et miserere mei, Domine, quoniam unicus et pauper sum ego. Vide humilitatem meam et laborem meum, et dimitte omnia peccata mea, Deus meus.
entrance_antiphon.english: Turn to me and have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am alone and poor. See my lowliness and suffering and take away all my sins, my God.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ego clamavi, quoniam exaudisti me, Deus: inclina aurem tuam, et exaudi verba mea.
communion_antiphon.english: To you I call, for you will surely heed me, O God; turn your ear to me; hear my words. Or: Amen dico vobis, quidquid orantes petitis, credite quia accipietis, et fiet vobis, dicit Dominus. Amen, I say to you: Whatever you ask for in prayer, believe you will receive it, and it will be yours, says the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Dominus illuminatio mea, et salus mea, quem timebo? Dominus defensor vitae meae, a quo trepidabo? Qui tribulant me inimici mei, ipsi infirmati sunt.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; whom should I dread? When those who do evil draw near, they stumble and fall.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dominus firmamentum meum, et refugium meum, et liberator meus. Deus meus adiutor meus.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God is my saving strength.

communion_antiphon.latin: Deus caritas est, et qui manet in caritate in Deo manet et Deus in eo.
communion_antiphon.english: God is love, and whoever abides in love abides in God, and God in him.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Exaudi, Domine, vocem meam, qua clamavi ad te. Adiutor meus esto, ne derelinquas me, neque despicias me, Deus salutaris meus.
entrance_antiphon.english: O Lord, hear my voice, for I have called to you; be my help. Do not abandon or forsake me, O God, my Savior!

communion_antiphon.latin: Unum petii a Domino, hoc requiram, ut inhabitem in domo Domini omnibus diebus vitae meae.
communion_antiphon.english: There is one thing I ask of the Lord, only this do I seek: to live in the house of the Lord all the days of my life.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Dominus fortitudo plebis suae, et protector salutarium Christi sui est. Salvum fac populum tuum, Domine, et benedic hereditati tuae, et rege eos usque in saeculum.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord is the strength of his people, a saving refuge for the one he has anointed. Save your people, Lord, and bless your heritage, and govern them for ever.

communion_antiphon.latin: Oculi omnium in te sperant, Domine, et tu das illis escam in tempore oportuno.
communion_antiphon.english: The eyes of all look to you, Lord, and you give them their food in due season.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Omnes gentes, plaudite manibus, iubilate Deo in voce exsultationis.
entrance_antiphon.english: All peoples, clap your hands. Cry to God with shouts of joy!

communion_antiphon.latin: Benedic, anima mea, Domino, et ea quae intra me sunt nomini sancto eius.
communion_antiphon.english: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all within me, his holy name.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Suscepimus, Deus, misericordiam tuam in medio templi tui. Secundum nomen tuum, Deus, ita et laus tua in fines terrae; iustitia plena est dextera tua.
entrance_antiphon.english: Your merciful love, O God, we have received in the midst of your temple. Your praise, O God, like your name, reaches the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with saving justice.

communion_antiphon.latin: Gustate et videte, quoniam suavis est Dominus; beatus vir, qui sperat in eo.
communion_antiphon.english: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed the man who seeks refuge in him.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ego autem cum iustitia apparebo in conspectu tuo; satiabor dum manifestabitur gloria tua.
entrance_antiphon.english: As for me, in justice I shall behold your face; I shall be filled with the vision of your glory.

communion_antiphon.latin: Passer invenit sibi domum, et turtur nidum, ubi reponat pullos suos: altaria tua, Domine virtutum, Rex meus, et Deus meus! Beati qui habitant in domo tua, in saeculum saeculi laudabunt te.
communion_antiphon.english: The sparrow finds a home, and the swallow a nest for her young: by your altars, O Lord of hosts, my King and my God. Blessed are they who dwell in your house, for ever singing your praise.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ecce Deus adiuvat me, et Dominus susceptor est animae meae. Voluntarie sacrificabo tibi, et confitebor nomini tuo, Domine, quoniam bonum est.
entrance_antiphon.english: See, I have God for my help. The Lord sustains my soul. I will sacrifice to you with willing heart, and praise your name, O Lord, for it is good.

communion_antiphon.latin: Memoriam fecit mirabilium suorum misericors et miserator Dominus; escam dedit timentibus se.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord, the gracious, the merciful, has made a memorial of his wonders; he gives food to those who fear him. Or: Ecce sto ad ostium et pulso, dicit Dominus: si quis audierit vocem meam, et aperuerit mihi ianuam, intrabo ad illum, et cenabo cum illo, et ipse mecum. Behold, I stand at the door and knock, says the Lord. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door to me, I will enter his house and dine with him, and he with me.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Deus in loco sancto suo; Deus qui inhabitare facit unanimes in domo, ipse dabit virtutem et fortitudinem plebi suae.
entrance_antiphon.english: God is in his holy place, God who unites those who dwell in his house; he himself gives might and strength to his people.

communion_antiphon.latin: Benedic, anima mea, Domino, et noli oblivisci omnes retributiones eius.
communion_antiphon.english: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and never forget all his benefits.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Deus, in adiutorium meum intende; Domine, ad adiuvandum me festina. Adiutor meus et liberator meus es tu; Domine, ne moreris.
entrance_antiphon.english: O God, come to my assistance; O Lord, make haste to help me! You are my rescuer, my help; O Lord, do not delay.

communion_antiphon.latin: Panem de caelo dedisti nobis, Domine, habentem omne delectamentum et omnem saporem suavitatis.
communion_antiphon.english: You have given us, O Lord, bread from heaven, endowed with all delights and sweetness in every taste.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Respice, Domine, in testamentum tuum, et animas pauperum tuorum ne derelinquas in finem. Exsurge, Domine, et iudica causam tuam, et ne obliviscarus voces quaerentium te.
entrance_antiphon.english: Look to your covenant, O Lord, and forget not the life of your poor ones for ever. Arise, O God, and defend your cause, and forget not the cries of those who seek you.

communion_antiphon.latin: Lauda, Ierusalem, Dominum, qui adipe frumenti satiat te.
communion_antiphon.english: O Jerusalem, glorify the Lord, who gives you your fill of finest wheat.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Protector noster, aspice, Deus, et respice in faciem Christi tui, quia melior est dies una in atriis tuis super millia.
entrance_antiphon.english: Turn your eyes, O God, our shield; and look on the face of your anointed one; one day within your courts is better than a thousand elsewhere.

communion_antiphon.latin: Apud Dominum misericordia, et copiosa apud eum redemptio.
communion_antiphon.english: With the Lord there is mercy; in him is plentiful redemption.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Inclina Domine, aurem tuam ad me, et exaudi me. Salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperantem in te. Miserere mihi, Domine, quoniam ad te clamavi tota die.
entrance_antiphon.english: Turn your ear, O Lord, and answer me; save the servant who trusts in you, my God. Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I cry to you all the day long.

communion_antiphon.latin: De fructu operum tuorum, Domine, satiabitur terra, ut educas panem de terra, et vinum laetificet cor hominis.
communion_antiphon.english: The earth is replete with the fruits of your work, O Lord; you bring forth bread from the earth and wine to cheer the heart.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Miserere mihi, Domine, quoniam ad te clamavi tota die: quia tu, Domine, suavis ac mitis es, et copiosus in misericordia omnibus invocantibus te.
entrance_antiphon.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I cry to you all the day long. O Lord, you are good and forgiving, full of mercy to all who call to you.

communion_antiphon.latin: Quam magna multitudo dulcedinis tuae, Domine, quam abscondisti timentibus te.
communion_antiphon.english: How great is the goodness, Lord, that you keep for those who fear you.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Iustus es, Domine, et rectum iudicium tuum; fac cum servo tuo secundum misericordiam tuam.
entrance_antiphon.english: You are just, O Lord, and your judgment is right; treat your servant in accord with your merciful love.

communion_antiphon.latin: Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum, ita desiderat anima mea ad te, Deus: sitivit anima mea ad Deum fontem vivum.
communion_antiphon.english: Like the deer that yearns for running streams, so my soul is yearning for you, my God; my soul is thirsting for God, the living God.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Da pacem, Domine, sustinentibus te, ut prophetae tui fideles inveniantur; exaudi preces servi tui, et plebis tuae Israel.
entrance_antiphon.english: Give peace, O Lord, to those who wait for you, that your prophets be found true. Hear the prayers of your servant, and of your people Israel.

communion_antiphon.latin: Quam pretiosa est misericordia tua, Deus! Filii hominum sub umbra alarum tuarum confugient.
communion_antiphon.english: How precious is your mercy, O God! The children of men seek shelter in the shadow of your wings.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Salus populi ego sum, dicit Dominus. De quacumque tribulatione clamaverint ad me, exaudiam eos, et ero illorum Dominus in perpetuum.
entrance_antiphon.english: I am the salvation of the people, says the Lord. Should they cry to me in any distress, I will hear them, and I will be their Lord for ever.

communion_antiphon.latin: Tu mandasti mandata tua custodiri nimis; utinam dirigantur viae meae ad custodiendas iustificationes tuas.
communion_antiphon.english: You have laid down your precepts to be carefully kept; may my ways be firm in keeping your statutes.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Omnia, quae fecisti nobis, Domine, in vero iudicio fecisti, quia peccavimus tibi, et mandatis tuis non oboedivimus; sed da gloriam nomini tuo, et fac nobiscum secundum multitudinem misericordiae tuae.
entrance_antiphon.english: All that you have done to us, O Lord, you have done with true judgment, for we have sinned against you and not obeyed your commandments. But give glory to your name and deal with us according to the bounty of your mercy.

communion_antiphon.latin: Memento verbi tui servo tuo, Domine, in quo mihi spem dedisti; haec me consolata est in humilitate mea.
communion_antiphon.english: Remember your word to your servant, O Lord, by which you have given me hope. This is my comfort when I am brought low.

entrance_antiphon.latin: In voluntate tua, Domine, universa sunt posita, et non est qui possit resistere voluntati tuae. Tu enim fecisti omnia, caelum et terram, et universa quae caeli ambitu continentur; Dominus universorum tu es.
entrance_antiphon.english: Within your will, O Lord, all things are established, and there is none that can resist your will. For you have made all things, the heaven and the earth, and all that is held within the circle of heaven; you are the Lord of all.

communion_antiphon.latin: Bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum, anime quaerenti illum.
communion_antiphon.english: The LORD is good to those who hope in him, to the soul that seeks him.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Si iniquitates observaveris, Domine, Domine, quis sustinebit? Quia apud te propitiatio est, Deus Israel.
entrance_antiphon.english: If you, O Lord, should mark iniquities, Lord, who could stand? But with you is found forgiveness, O God of Israel.

communion_antiphon.latin: Divites eguerunt et esurierunt; quaerentes autem Dominum non minuentur omni bono.
communion_antiphon.english: The rich suffer want and go hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no blessing.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ego clamavi, quoniam exaudisti me, Deus: inclina aurem tuam, et exaudi verba mea: Custodi me, Domine, ut pupillam oculi; sub umbra alarum tuarum protege me.
entrance_antiphon.english: To you I call; for you will surely heed me, O God; turn your ear to me; hear my words. Guard me as the apple of your eye; in the shadow of your wings protect me.

communion_antiphon.latin: Ecce oculi Domini super timentes eum, et in eis, qui sperant super misericordia; eius ut eruat a morte animas eorum: et alat eos in fame.
communion_antiphon.english: Behold, the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him, who hope in his merciful love, to rescue their souls from death, to keep them alive in famine.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Laetetur cor quaerentium Dominum. Quaerite Dominum, et confirmamini; quaerite faciem eius semper.
entrance_antiphon.english: Let the hearts that seek the Lord rejoice; turn to the Lord and his strength; constantly seek his face.

communion_antiphon.latin: Laetabimur in salutari tuo, et in nomine Dei nostri magnificabimur.
communion_antiphon.english: We will ring out our joy at your saving help and exult in the name of our God.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Ne derelinquas me, Domine Deus meus, ne discedas a me; intende in adiutorium meum, Domine, virtus salutis meae.
entrance_antiphon.english: Forsake me not, O Lord, my God; be not far from me! Make haste and come to my help, O Lord, my strong salvation!

communion_antiphon.latin: Notas mihi fecisti vias vitae, adimplebis me laetitia cum vultu tuo, Domine.
communion_antiphon.english: You will show me the path of life, the fullness of joy in your presence, O Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Intret oratio mea in conspectu tuo; inclina aurem tuam ad precem meam, Domine.
entrance_antiphon.english: Let my prayer come into your presence. Incline your ear to my cry for help, O Lord.

communion_antiphon.latin: Dominus regit me, et nihil mihi deerit: in loco pascuae, ibi me collocavit, super aquam refectionis educavit me.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord is my shepherd; there is nothing I shall want. Fresh and green are the pastures where he gives me repose, near restful waters he leads me.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Dicit Dominus: Ego cogito cogitationes pacis, et non afflictionis; invocabitis me, et ego exaudiam vos: et reducam captivitatem vestram de cunctis locis.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord said: I think thoughts of peace and not of affliction. You will call upon me, and I will answer you, and I will lead back your captives from every place.

communion_antiphon.latin: Mihi autem adhaerere deo bonum est ponere in Domino Deo spem meam.
communion_antiphon.english: To be near God is my happiness, to place my hope in God the Lord.

entrance_antiphon.latin: Dignus est Agnus, qui occisus est, accipere virtutem, et divinitatem, et sapientiam, et fortitudinem, et honorem. Ipsi gloria et imperium in saecula saeculorum.
entrance_antiphon.english: How worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and divinity, and wisdom and strength and honor. To him belong glory and power for ever and ever.

communion_antiphon.latin: Sedebit Dominus Rex in aeternum. Dominus benedicet populo suo in pace.
communion_antiphon.english: The Lord sits as King for ever. The Lord will bless his people with peace.

title: Weekdays of the 34th Week in Ordinary Time

entrance_antiphon.latin: Loquetur Dominus pacem in plebem suam, et super sanctos suos, et in eos qui convertuntur ad ipsum.
entrance_antiphon.english: The Lord speaks of peace to his people and his holy ones and to those who turn to him.

communion_antiphon.latin: Laudate Dominum, omnes gentes, quoniam confirmata est super nos misericordia eius.
communion_antiphon.english: O praise the Lord, all you nations, for his merciful love towards us is great. Or: Ecce ego vobiscum sum omnibus diebus, usque ad consummationem saeculi, dicit Dominus. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age, says the Lord.
